descriptions.zh: 这是虚境的意志，你们的世界将被拜访。这些外来者是否会带来坏消息仍是个有待探索的奥秘。
descriptions.en: It is the will of the Shroud that your worlds be visited. Whether these strangers bring ill tidings or not is a mystery yet to be experienced.

sections.zh: 我们亲自找出这些来访者，拥抱虚境的意志
sections.en: We embrace the Shroud's will by seeking out these visitors ourselves

sections.zh: 我们拒绝来访者进入我们的领地，违背虚境的意志
sections.en: We defy the Shroud's will by denying visitors access to our territory

descriptions.zh: 这是虚境的意志，你周围的空间以新的形式呈现。谨慎但大胆地行走吧，要考虑前方的道路上可能会有什么奇迹。
descriptions.en: It is the will of the Shroud that the space around you take on new forms. Tread carefully but boldly, and consider what marvels may lie on the paths ahead.

sections.zh: 我们探索这些道路，拥抱虚境的意志
sections.en: We embrace the Shroud's will by exploring these paths ourselves

sections.zh: 我们保持不动并保卫我们的领地，违背虚境的意志
sections.en: We defy the Shroud's will by remaining still, and guarding our territory

sections.zh: 我们探索这些道路，拥抱虚境的意志
sections.en: We embrace the Shroud's will by exploring these paths ourselves

sections.zh: 我们保持不动并保卫我们的领地，违背虚境的意志
sections.en: We defy the Shroud's will by remaining still, and guarding our territory

descriptions.zh: [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]会凝视虚境，以期获得对[Target.GetName]的内部运作具有指导意义的见解。
descriptions.en: The [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] will peer into the Shroud in hopes of gaining insight into the inner workings of the [Target.GetName].

sections.zh: 我们对虚境的掌控加速了这个进程，允许我们协助[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]的任务。
sections.en: Our mastery of the Shroud hastens the process and allows us to assist the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] with their task.
